title: The Kirby band: length, personnel and dates
summary: About two years at the Onyx with Frankie Newton and Buster Bailey; Leo Watson replaced them; the band did not record under Moore.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: I see. Well, we're down to the Kirby period. You mentioned that Kirby came down with his bass and he had a job pending on the Onyx Club on 52nd Street. And your trio joined him and became part of the first John Kirby group.
Yes.
So you played... How long did you play with him? How long did that group stay together?
We stayed down at the Onyx Club for about two years.
Oh, it was about two years.
Yes. Myself, Pete Brown, Don Frye, of course John Kirby, and he had Frankie Newton and I forget whether we used...
I think Buster Bailey came in there.
Buster Bailey on some of them. He used sometimes... He didn't use no trombones; it wasn't that kind of band. It was just not the Swing band.
Moore (III) - 16
Well, who was your guitar player at that time? Or was there a guitar at that time? Was Teddy Bunn with the band then? Did he join the band?
That would have to be...
That was later.
After we left.
So you were with him about two years. And when you left, was it Leo Watson or...?
Leo Watson taken our place.
He took your place. Okay, fine. Now, let's try to pin down the dates. You were with Kirby from about when? About 1937?
Somewhere around there.
Around '36 to '37.
Yes.
But that band didn't record, apparently.
No, not with that one.
Well, did he change personnel to make recordings?

He changed his personnel. I think they had cut a recording. I don't remember now. But the arrangement was different, because of a trumpet player after... After we left, then they got another trumpet player, which was..
Charlie Shavers?
Moore (III) - 17
Charlie Shavers, yes.
I see. What I'm trying to establish is that while you were with the John Kirby Band, sometimes Kirby went into the studio with other people.
Yes.
But he still had his Onyx Club band, and then he would record with other people.
